_comment: Every file rustc reads when compiling the desktop library crate, per macOS build configuration, relative to src-tauri/. verify-native-boundary.mjs compares this with the compiler's own dep-info, so a module added through any declaration form, a path attribute or an include macro fails until it is listed here. config.test.ts applies the project registry content rules to the listed src/projects files. Changing this list is a security review decision.
